about_the_game:
Hello all, here's the PolyZ Supporter Pack, a special bundle for those who want to further empower the solo developer behind PolyZ! This pack isn't just about showing your appreciation; it's packed with exclusive features and striking cosmetics that will enhance your game experience.

Here's what you'll get in the bundle:

  • Custom Color Tracer Rounds: Light up the battlefield your way! You can now personalize your tracer bullet visuals with a custom color of your choice. Make your mark with every shot!

  • Expanded Secure Container (9x4): Never run out of secure storage again. This larger 9x4 secure container gives you ample space to protect your most valuable loot from unexpected encounters.

  • Golden Assault Rifle Skin: Stand out from the crowd with the shimmering Golden Assault Rifle skin. Equip this prestigious cosmetic and let everyone know you're a true PolyZ supporter.

Grab the Supporter Pack today and help us continue to grow PolyZ!
